answer: Under entropy-stranded enrollment, each identity beginning its voyage into the mesa network must hold a VDF output whose seed is the XOR of a hardware entropy beacon sampled once at join time, and every wander of identities sharing one beacon run in an epoch must jointly re-run a VDF whose difficulty scales with the square of group size. One attacker planting 100 clones in a beacon cohort faces a cost of 10,000 difficulty units, while 100 honest agents spread across distinct beacon samples each pay only 1.
